Home Hotels & Resorts Fairmont Hanoi Location & Contact AT THE heart OF HANOI'S OLD QUARTER Fairmont Hanoi is perfectly located in the historic Old Quarter, just steps from Hoan Kiem Lake and the iconic Opera House. Nestled between the French Quarter and the Red River, the hotel offers unrivaled access to Hanoi’s cultural landmarks, vibrant 36 streets, and thriving business district. Our Concierge is pleased to arrange private airport transfers for a seamless arrival. Guests may also choose reliable metered taxis or app-based ride-hailing services such as Grab and Xanh SM, available directly at the terminal for convenient travel to the hotel.

TAXIS Metered taxis and ride-hailing services such as Grab are widely available at Noi Bai International Airport and throughout Hanoi. Travel time to the hotel is approximately 35-40 minutes depending on traffic. Guests are advised to use official taxi companies or app-based rides for reliability and transparent pricing.

DRIVING INSTRUCTIONS From Noi Bai International Airport, take the Nhat Tan Bridge (Vo Nguyen Giap Expressway) toward central Hanoi. Continue straight for about 26 km, following signs for Hoan Kiem District. The drive takes around 40 minutes. Fairmont Hanoi is located at 10 Tran Nguyen Han, steps from Hoan Kiem Lake and the Hanoi Opera House.
